accepted.label: Territory mapped using satellite data for groundwater detection
accepted.subject: UNICEF

evidence.text:
Leading, convening and pioneering
Horn of Africa: Core Resources scaled up an innovative solution using satellite data 
to detect groundwater, mapping nearly a million square kilometres of territory in 
drought-prone countries, with the potential to benefit 10 million people in need.

accepted.label: Government investment in social protection programmes
accepted.subject: Guatemala

evidence.text:
Guatemala: Core Resources positioned UNICEF as a key partner in the transformation 
of the social protection system, offering the government strategic policy advice and 
partnerships, which resulted in a $1 billion investment in social protection 
programmes and mitigation of a three-to-four-fold increase in poverty during 
the COVID-19 pandemic.

accepted.quote:

partnerships, which resulted in a $1 billion investment in social protection 
programmes and mitigation of a three-to-four-fold increase in poverty during 
the COVID-19 pandemic.

of cyclones.

accepted.label: Provinces with Inclusive Education Resource Centres
accepted.subject: Viet Nam

evidence.text:
Viet Nam: Core Resources supported a more inclusive system for access to learning 
opportunities for children with disabilities, embedded disability inclusion into national teacher 
training, and enabled scaling up the Inclusive Education Resource Centres across  
14 provinces to prepare children with disabilities to enter mainstream classrooms.

accepted.quote:

training, and enabled scaling up the Inclusive Education Resource Centres across
